config.note: Series keys are country|indicator. Actuals through the release's last actual year, IMF projections after it (usually five years ahead); the two are not distinguished in the file, so treat the last five or six years as forecasts. Percent for rates, USD (full dollars, not billions) for NGDPD, USD for NGDPDPC

units.NGDP_RPCH: percent change on a year earlier
units.PCPIPCH: percent change on a year earlier, period average
units.PCPIEPCH: percent change on a year earlier, end of period
units.NGDPD: current US dollars (full dollars, not billions)
